_about: Place centroids (internal points) from the U.S. Census Bureau 2024 Gazetteer: county subdivisions for Massachusetts, Rhode Island, New York, Michigan and Ohio towns, cities and townships; counties for Virginia, Maryland, Michigan and Ohio counties and Virginia's and Baltimore's independent cities; places for Virginia towns and Maryland municipalities (https://www2.census.gov/geo/docs/maps-data/data/gazetteer/2024_Gazetteer/). Public domain. Used only to draw the maps on the site.
